subtasks: Pour the liquid from the first violet bottle into the first white bowl, from the second red bottle into the second black bowl, and from the third turquoise bottle into the third brown bowl. Then reset the robot arm.
Return the violet bottle upright to its original left position on the table and release it.
Pour the red bottle on the right into the black bowl on the left. Let the liquid settle and return the red bottle upright.
Use the left gripper to pick up the fallen red bottle on the left and pour its liquid into the black bowl. Return the red bottle upright.
